annotations.text:
1. This Week
Weekly view grouped by subject. Tap a task to complete; tap the FAB to add one.

2. New Task / Routine
Subject picker, weekly recurrence, alarm time + deadline. Every text field has a mic icon for voice-to-text.

3. Alarm firing
Full-screen state when a task's alarm rings. Complete, carry forward, or reschedule from here.

4. Reschedule sheet
Shown after 'Carry forward' or 'Reschedule' — user must set the new alarm time before confirming.

5. Summary
Weekly report: completed / missed / carried-forward counts, a day-by-day strip, and per-subject progress.
